verdicts.reason: A rebuilds the layout as a clean vertical story: the product sits in its circle on top, and below it the text is left-aligned with clear size steps and plenty of room. Its flaws are about 100px of dead space above the circle and a '20% off' headline that is a little small for this canvas. B blows the type up until it is cramped: '20% off' runs almost to the right edge, the subhead sits jammed against an oversized CTA, the circle is cropped off the top-right corner and pushed behind the text, and the product floats alone in empty space. The fine print 'Ends Sunday. Online only.' is set nearly as large as the subhead, so the hierarchy is broken.
